title: kaiak gateway status
description: The body of POST /v1/status (docs/specs/CONTROL-PROTOCOL.md, Gateway status).

protocol_version.description: The protocol version the gateway speaks.

applied_config_hash.description: The config_hash of the config in force; null before the first config from the control plane is applied, and while the seed config is in force.

last_rejection.description: The latest config received from the control plane, when the gateway rejected it; null once a later config is applied, and before any rejection.

codes.description: The rejection's issue codes: syntax, schema, a semantic rule code, or a gateway-only code.

backends.description: Every backend of the applied config, and any other backend with requests still in flight (dropped by a reload); empty before the first config is applied.

in_flight.description: Requests in flight on the backend.

max_in_flight.description: The backend's cap from the applied config, as configured (the fleet-wide cap, not this gateway's share); absent = no cap.

deployments.description: The circuit of each of the applied config's deployments on this backend, keyed by the model name on the backend.

models.description: Every model of the applied config; empty before the first config is applied.

queued.description: Requests waiting in the model's queue.

circuit.description: closed: serving. open: out of rotation, waiting for a probe. half_open: a probe succeeded; the next request is the trial that closes or re-opens it.

opened_at.description: When the circuit opened; present exactly when it is open or half-open (a half-open circuit keeps its opening time).
